gemini.title: English Language Skill Intzones
gemini.abstract: English Language Skill Intzones is an authoritative dataset published by National Records of Scotland. It contains records relating to english language skill intzones.
gemini.lineage: Published by National Records of Scotland as open statistics and boundary data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.
